entities.name: PMID:27512969
observations: In Ang II-infused mice, class II HDAC inhibitor MC1568 reduced blood pressure and attenuated remodeling in renal small arteries and thoracic aorta; the abstract implicates a CaMKIIα/PKD1/HDAC4/GATA6 pathway.
HDAC4 and GATA6 proteins increased with Ang II; GATA6 was described as a binding partner of HDAC4, and overexpression increased VSMC size and number.

entities.name: PMID:31223486
observations: In Ang II hypertensive mice, selective HDAC8 inhibitor PCI34051 reduced vascular hypertrophy and GATA6 mRNA, alongside blood pressure and inflammatory markers.

entities.name: HDAC4
observations: Ang II increased phosphorylated HDAC4 in arteries; experimental manipulation affected VSMC proliferation and cell-cycle gene expression; HDAC4 associated with GATA6 in the reported study.

entities.name: GATA6
observations: Ang II increased GATA6 protein in arteries; GATA6 was reported as a binding partner of HDAC4 and enhanced VSMC size and number when overexpressed.
Selective HDAC8 inhibition reduced GATA6 mRNA in Ang II hypertensive mice.

entities.name: HDAC8
observations: Selective inhibition with PCI34051 reduced vascular hypertrophy and GATA6 mRNA in an Ang II hypertensive mouse model.
